notes.title: Our plans
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]TomoToro are not sitting idle. Very soon we will update the Graces, adding new languages: Spanish, Ukrainian, Chinese and Japanese. Many thanks to those who helped us in this difficult task![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973912/8c4e4c0721c55aa52fbbc5e27804a1671f2bfe55.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We are also working hard on Amnea28 so that you could enjoy this amazing story. Recently we updated the trailer, improving the graphics and visual effects. What kind of improvements, you might ask? Perhaps it is worth telling in more detail.[/p][p]Amnea28 was originally released in 2022, and now, for the release on Steam, we are updating the backgrounds and CG arts. Yes, Amnea was created before Graces, which will probably be pretty noticeable. But we are trying to do everything we can so that you can enjoy not only the complex story of the old hotel, but also beautiful illustrations. Listed below are several examples of the new arts.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="AXleU3EsHr8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]If the story of Amnea intrigues you, do not forget to add the game to your wishlist! This is very important to us! We love you and are doing our utmost to release the game![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973912/73cebffbade065eb3b3b71b1668a4367acc12912.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973912/bb648907eba1febcc8261eb6ae21be09b5605983.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo of «Amnea28» is out!
notes.content:
We've been working hard for a long time, and finally the demo of another our novel «Amnea28» is out on Steam! 

«Amnea28» is a novel we created in 2022, before «Graces», but it just so happened that it's only being released on this platform now. It's much bigger than «Graces», so we'd like to believe that the stay in the old hotel will be to your liking and you'll be able to solve all its mysteries!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920257/9ebb05dc4609abc370b7bba54336abf0e38006ac.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920257/d9cce44a4a8b50331365b7fee8a8ae42073a925a.png[/img]

∞ "Amnea 28" is a visual novel about a group of young people who go to listen to a course of lectures by a respected professor of psychology. Their destination is "Amnea", an old hotel which ceased to fulfill its main functions ten years ago and now serves as the professor's residence. Week of studying didn't promise any problems, yet the atmosphere felt more unsettling with each passing day. 

∞ Why did the students' behavior suddenly become strange? What are they hiding? The protagonist will have to solve all the mysteries of "Amnea", otherwise the walls of the old hotel won't let her leave alive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920257/aa131bce0ef808276a0073513c35566f9ada4ff1.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920257/d54170beaffb5c45060e85173f3a6bd5148294fc.png[/img]

∞ About 1.5-2 hours of the story's prologue

∞ The introduction of the protagonist and 4 main characters, as well as the cameos of 4 side characters (the protagonist can't romance anyone; however there are certain romantic subplots in the story)

∞ 11 CGs, 6 extra arts and atmospheric soundtrack

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44920257/16190f859d0566b3f4c93ba16db1544a210eeefb.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch with fixes!
notes.content:
It's been more than a week since the release, we've received indispensable feedback and prepared a patch fixing typos and some technical issues.

What's changed:
- fixed typos
- fixed minor errors in images
- added font size selection (if you used ren py font settings and now the font is displayed incorrectly - you need to go to the settings and reset to the original values)

Now we are working on proofreading English text and the possibility to add other languages!
Thank you for being with us and leaving your feedback!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973912/ef9628658dd0f61c6a1641dc9623cb2a399d65e2.png[/img]

notes.title: The release day!
notes.content:
The release day has arrived!
We are pleased to present our mystical story that will definitely not leave you indifferent. Help Aki break the curse and decide her fate!

Our team is very fond of mystical horrors and we tried to carry over the spirit of high school horror stories and creepypastas. Every bad ending is like a unique creepypasta, and we recommend reading all of them!

Is it possible to change the fate of the heroines? Read «Graces: Posthumous Wish» and find out!

notes.title: Release on November 20th!
notes.content:
Graces: Posthumous Wish releases on November 20th!

With less than a week to go, we are pretty excited and make all preparations for the release of our mystery novel where scary ghost tales intertwine with the dramatic stories of heroines.

Soon the mystery of Mitsuki's death will be solved!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973912/9d78992c60656e746f4329ce46f4a442180e3cf1.jpg[/img]
